note: The dye vat (docs/43 section 8, #412; src/dye.js). `colours` are the dyes a vat gives, each a name and a hex: the light tone a region takes, its shade the engine's (a painted garment's dark key becomes the colour darkened, docs/28). `palettes` are lists of colour ids an item's `dye` block names for a region (`palette`), or a region lists its own `colours`; a two-region item may instead list `schemes`, a colour id per region, and then only those are offered (a new scheme is one line of data, no new art). An item's own colours (its `art.colours`) are always offered first, as Undyed. `unlock` is Crafting 3, open to all until the skills are built (docs/43 section 1). The cost hook: a colour may name `cost`, a list of {item, count} taken from what the player carries when it is applied; none does, so a dye costs nothing until #288 rules whether it costs a plant (woad, madder, weld). Primary's palette, Michael's to change here.
